name: BACH_0250
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (87%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Low reliability (46%) [F6], cross-model disagreement, and 4/5 Normal neighbors reduce confidence.

## Confidence
|Signal | Value | Reading|
|---|---|---|
|Top probabilities | InSitu 87%, Normal 12%, Benign 0%, Invasive 0% [F1] | Favors InSitu; 0% invasive risk|
|Conformal set | {InSitu} (alpha=0.1, 90% coverage) | Single-class set at 90% guarantee|
|Reliability / OOD | 46% reliability, 88th OOD percentile (flagged) | Suspect input; atypical vs training|
|CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (disagree on top class) | Independent foundation models disagree|
|Similar cases | 1/5 InSitu (20%), 4/5 Normal [F5] | Nearest neighbors mostly Normal|

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 3, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Pushes against invasion (-0.73) [F2]; 0/20 spot-check is unreliable · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Pushes against invasion (-0.57) [F3]; 20/20 spot-check · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Pushes toward invasion (+0.23) [F4]; 19/20 spot-check · Validated
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 3, 4, 5) · context · 73% neoplastic nuclei (97th percentile; 169 in region 5) [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; top-3 risk deletion drops P(invasive) above random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); uses unreliable `normal_lobules` (0/20 spot-check).

## Could be wrong if
- Low-reliability section is Normal (12%), matching 4/5 neighbors (`BACH_0343`, 87% similarity) despite HoVer-Net counts.
- Region 11 infiltration or deeper levels harbor invasion missed due to poor quality and model disagreement.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 4, 3**: Verify neoplastic nuclei (169, 51, 16; 0% benign epithelium [F8]) and top risk.
2. **Regions 6, 5**: Confirm duct-confined atypia (InSitu) vs Normal before ordering drafted `ER` stain.
3. **Regions 11, 10, 9**: Exclude invasion in 11 and artifact; consider drafted `recut H&E` or `deeper levels`.
